5828.title: Diff-toolbar controls lack visible hover descriptions
5828.rootCauseOneLine: The toolbar renders five icon Buttons with accessible labels but never composes the shared tooltip primitives.

prReviews.topFinding: The diff supplies shared tooltip wrappers for all five actions but adds no regression test.

5828.proposedFix: Use shared Tooltip primitives with the current action labels and retain the embedded hover regression. No duplicate fix PR: open PR #5829 already closes this issue.
5828.caveats: Same-agent clean-checkout repetition. Component-level test and isolated source-component browser captures, not full-app navigation. Complete regression patch is inline in the HTML.
